hero.title: Cryptographic proof for DJ mixes
hero.subtitle: FREK® establishes a universal standard for identifying composite musical performances. Each mix becomes a verifiable, timestamped, immutable fact.

philosophy.title: Why FREK exists

pillar1.title: Proof > Service
pillar1.description: FREK doesn't depend on any platform. Your attestations belong to you, readable in 2050.

pillar2.title: Local-First
pillar2.description: All computation runs on your device. No data leaves your machine.

pillar3.title: Anti-Surveillance
pillar3.description: Zero tracking, zero analytics. Your art, your rules.

philosophy.quote: FREK doesn't recognize music. FREK recognizes a technical fact, in a precise context.

verifier.title: Verify an attestation
verifier.subtitle: Drop an audio file to generate its fingerprint, or a .frek.json file to verify its validity.

dropzone.audioFormats: MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG — Max 500MB

step2.title: Tracklist
step2.description: The tracklist strengthens the probative value of the attestation. It's not mandatory but strongly recommended.
step2.optional: This step is optional. You can proceed to the next step even without a tracklist.

step3.title: Audio Fingerprint
step3.description: The audio fingerprint is the heart of the FREK attestation. It allows verification of the mix's authenticity.
step3.formats: MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG — Max 500MB — Local FFT analysis
step3.manualWarning: Without an audio file, the probative value is reduced. You can complete this attestation later.

step4.title: Review & Generation
step4.description: Check the information before generating your FREK attestation.
step4.keepFile: Keep this file — it constitutes your proof.

validation.noFingerprint: No audio fingerprint — reduced probative value
